fusions.name: All in a Row
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of water into the first enemy it meets for 6 damage. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Spreading Wake
fusions.desc: Sends a wake out in a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Water Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You also have 10% water resistance.

fusions.name: Unruffled Surface
fusions.desc: When your health is full, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
